scope: Selected standard hardware and material for an authored G1 camera collar; not historical paper equipment

sources.facts: ISO 4032 M3 nut: 5.5 mm across flats and 2.4 mm height.
sources.inferred: Unthreaded internal bore represents fastener contact envelope.

sources.facts: Manufacturer M3 ISO 7089 drawing: 3.2 mm bore, 7 mm outside diameter, 0.5 mm thickness. Drawing linked, not redistributed.
